title: Illuminara — Visual Series 01
source: BD-supplied 120 responsive HD/4K WebP assets; byte-preserving Git blob upload

artworks.title: Summer Adriatic
artworks.caption: Barefoot at the water's edge, Illuminara lets the Adriatic sunset set the pace. For a moment, there is nothing to rescue and no decision to force.
artworks.captionSl: Bosa na robu morja Illuminara prepusti ritem jadranskemu sončnemu zahodu. Za hip ni nikogar, ki bi ga bilo treba rešiti, in nobene odločitve, ki bi jo bilo treba izsiliti.

artworks.title: Winter Alpine Aurora
artworks.caption: Northern lights ripple above snowy peaks and a silent lake. Wrapped against the cold, she watches the sky without trying to interpret it for anyone.
artworks.captionSl: Severni sij valovi nad zasneženimi vrhovi in tihim jezerom. Zavita pred mrazom opazuje nebo, ne da bi skušala drugim razložiti, kaj morajo videti.

artworks.title: Renaissance Observatory
artworks.caption: Around an armillary sphere, scholars lean over charts and unfinished calculations. Illuminara joins their inquiry as a listener, not the voice that ends it.
artworks.captionSl: Ob astronomskem krogelnem modelu se učenjaki sklanjajo nad zemljevidi in nedokončanimi izračuni. Illuminara se njihovemu raziskovanju pridruži kot poslušalka, ne kot glas, ki bi razpravo končal.

artworks.title: Orbital Garden
artworks.caption: In a glass garden above the blue curve of Earth, she examines a small green branch. Immense distance makes this living detail feel more precious, not smaller.
artworks.captionSl: V steklenem vrtu nad modrim lokom Zemlje opazuje drobno zeleno vejico. Neizmerna razdalja te žive podrobnosti ne zmanjša, temveč ji da še večjo vrednost.

artworks.title: Summer Picnic
artworks.caption: A shared picnic beneath the trees: conversation, fruit, and late-summer light. Her power has no part to play in the simple work of being present.
artworks.captionSl: Skupni piknik pod drevesi: pogovor, sadje in pozno poletno sonce. Njena moč nima nobene vloge pri preprosti, a dragoceni umetnosti biti navzoča.

artworks.title: Winter Train 1925
artworks.caption: Snowy mountains pass beyond a warm, wood-paneled train carriage while she reads. An ordinary private pause on a journey through an earlier century.
artworks.captionSl: Za oknom toplega vagona z lesenimi oblogami drsijo zasnežene gore, ona pa bere. Običajen, zaseben trenutek miru na poti skozi neko preteklo stoletje.

artworks.title: Evening Piano
artworks.caption: At the grand piano, her hands move beneath warm stage lights. The listeners beyond the keyboard make this performance feel like a conversation without words.
artworks.captionSl: Za koncertnim klavirjem se njene roke premikajo v topli odrski svetlobi. Poslušalci na drugi strani tipk spreminjajo nastop v pogovor brez besed.

artworks.title: Rainy Future City CORRECTED
artworks.caption: Rain turns a future city's towers into reflections across the pavement. Beneath a transparent umbrella, she looks back as the crowd continues through the lights.
artworks.captionSl: Dež razlije odseve stolpnic mesta prihodnosti po mokrem pločniku. Pod prozornim dežnikom se ozre nazaj, medtem ko množica nadaljuje pot skozi luči.

artworks.title: Summer Sailing
artworks.caption: Leaning into the movement of the sailboat, she laughs as sea spray rises. Other sailors work around her and open water stretches beyond the deck.
artworks.captionSl: Nagne se v gibanje jadrnice in se zasmeje, ko se dvigne morski pršec. Drugi jadralci so zbrani okoli nje, za palubo pa se odpira široko morje.

artworks.title: Winter Market 1900
artworks.caption: Beneath lanterns and falling snow, she shares a smile with a market seller. The warmth of an ordinary exchange briefly outshines the wintry square.
artworks.captionSl: Pod svetilkami in med padajočimi snežinkami si izmenja nasmeh s prodajalko na tržnici. Toplina vsakdanjega srečanja za hip zasenči zimski trg.

artworks.title: Nocturnal Guardian
artworks.caption: A cloaked opponent advances across rain-slick stone while Illuminara holds her ground. The midnight skyline watches over a confrontation not yet decided.
artworks.captionSl: Zamaskirani nasprotnik stopa po dežju spolzkem kamnu, Illuminara pa ne odstopi. Polnočna mestna silhueta obdaja soočenje, katerega izid še ni odločen.

artworks.title: Captain Aegis
artworks.caption: The captain's armored shield meets a measured sweep of luminous force. Neither figure disappears into the impact; the sunlit city remains around them.
artworks.captionSl: Kapitanov oklepni ščit prestreže nadzorovan val svetlobne sile. Nobena od figur ne izgine v trku; s soncem obsijano mesto ostaja razločno okoli njiju.

artworks.title: Weaver Terrace
artworks.caption: On a high terrace, luminous strands curve between Illuminara's hands while a masked figure stands nearby. This looks more like careful weaving than a display of force.
artworks.captionSl: Na visoki terasi se med Illuminarinimi rokami spletajo svetleče niti, ob njej pa stoji zamaskirana figura. Prizor bolj kot razkazovanje moči spominja na natančno tkanje.

artworks.title: Ferrum Hangar
artworks.caption: A blue energy beam slices through the vast hangar. Beneath the suspended machine, Illuminara meets its path with a small, controlled circle of light.
artworks.captionSl: Moder energijski žarek prereže ogromen hangar. Pod lebdečim strojem Illuminara njegovo pot ujame v majhen, skrbno nadzorovan krog svetlobe.

artworks.title: Titan Quarry
artworks.caption: A giant made of stone looms above a shattered quarry floor. Illuminara kneels among the rubble and raises a bright arc against the force bearing down on her.
artworks.captionSl: Velikan iz kamna se dviga nad razbitimi tlemi kamnoloma. Illuminara kleči med ruševinami in proti sili, ki se spušča nadnjo, dvigne svetel lok.

artworks.title: Tonar Storm Causeway
artworks.caption: Waves hammer the broken causeway while lightning crosses the storm. Illuminara raises her hand beside an armored companion, resisting the force sweeping over the passage.
artworks.captionSl: Valovi udarjajo ob razrušen nasip, nebo pa režejo strele. Ob oklepljenem spremljevalcu Illuminara dvigne roko proti sili, ki preplavlja prehod.

artworks.title: Helion Train Rescue
artworks.caption: A caped rescuer steadies a train carriage high above the city while Illuminara reaches toward its damaged window. Two kinds of strength meet at one fragile point.
artworks.captionSl: Reševalec s plaščem visoko nad mestom podpira železniški vagon, Illuminara pa sega proti njegovemu poškodovanemu oknu. Dve vrsti moči se srečata na eni sami krhki točki.

artworks.title: Arcanor Observatory
artworks.caption: In the observatory's broken machinery, violet energy branches across the air. Illuminara reaches into its current as another figure braces behind a circular barrier.
artworks.captionSl: Med razbitimi mehanizmi observatorija se po zraku razvejajo vijolični tokovi energije. Illuminara sega vanje, druga figura pa se opira ob okroglo zaščitno pregrado.

artworks.title: Argent Planetary Rings
artworks.caption: Above the glittering rings of a giant planet, Illuminara and a silver figure balance on a narrow platform. The immense world below makes their shared position feel precarious.
artworks.captionSl: Nad bleščečimi obroči orjaškega planeta Illuminara in srebrna figura lovita ravnotežje na ozki ploščadi. Ogromni svet pod njima poudari krhkost njunega položaja.

artworks.title: Nexus Living Seed
artworks.caption: A blue figure holds out a luminous branching form while Illuminara cradles a small living plant. Their exchange is quiet beneath a sky too large to measure.
artworks.captionSl: Modra figura ponuja svetlečo razvejano obliko, Illuminara pa v rokah drži drobno živo rastlino. Njuna izmenjava je tiha pod nebom, ki mu ni mogoče izmeriti razsežnosti.

artworks.title: Obsidar Citadel
artworks.caption: An enormous armored figure rises above a collapsing citadel. Illuminara sends a bright arc through flying debris, holding her place amid the destruction.
artworks.captionSl: Ogromna oklepljena figura se dviga nad citadelo, ki se podira. Illuminara skozi leteče ruševine usmeri svetel lok in sredi uničenja ohranja svoj položaj.

artworks.title: Valora Courtyard
artworks.caption: Across a sunlit courtyard, a sword-bearing woman advances as Illuminara answers with an open hand. Steel, movement, and light hold the encounter in suspense.
artworks.captionSl: Na sončnem dvorišču se približuje ženska z mečem, Illuminara pa ji odgovori z odprto dlanjo. Jeklo, gibanje in svetloba ohranjajo napetost srečanja.

artworks.title: Velox Intersection
artworks.caption: Two people hurry across the wet crossing while Illuminara turns a burst of energy aside. In the middle of the street, protection opens a path through danger.
artworks.captionSl: Dva človeka hitita čez mokro križišče, Illuminara pa odkloni sunek energije. Sredi ulice zaščita odpre pot skozi nevarnost.

artworks.title: Solvar Harbor Rescue
artworks.caption: Above the battered harbor, a radiant figure braces against falling wreckage. On the ground below, Illuminara holds a luminous boundary as debris fills the sky.
artworks.captionSl: Nad poškodovanim pristaniščem se sijoča figura upira padajočim razbitinam. Na tleh pod njo Illuminara vzdržuje svetlečo zaščitno mejo, medtem ko nebo polnijo ruševine.

artworks.title: Pyralis Quiet Contact
artworks.caption: In a moonlit courtyard, Illuminara and a red-haired woman meet palm to palm. The light between them is gentle, leaving the meaning of their contact open.
artworks.captionSl: Na dvorišču v mesečini se Illuminara in rdečelasa ženska dotakneta z dlanema. Svetloba med njima je nežna, pomen njunega stika pa ostaja odprt.

artworks.title: Galakthar World
artworks.caption: Beneath spiral galaxies, a towering cosmic being reaches toward a lone figure on a ledge. Their difference in scale fills the sky without deciding what happens next.
artworks.captionSl: Pod spiralnimi galaksijami orjaško kozmično bitje sega proti osamljeni figuri na robu ploščadi. Razlika v njuni velikosti zapolni nebo, ne da bi določila, kaj se bo zgodilo.

artworks.title: Aeternor Attention
artworks.caption: Stars swirl into the outline of an immense presence above Illuminara. She looks upward, neither retreating nor pretending that the sight can be understood at a glance.
artworks.captionSl: Zvezde se nad Illuminaro vrtinčijo v obris neizmerne prisotnosti. Ona pogleda navzgor: ne umakne se in se ne pretvarja, da je mogoče vse razumeti z enim pogledom.

artworks.title: Trivor Defense
artworks.caption: A monumental figure framed by golden instruments holds a blue world before it. Below, Illuminara stands small, yet visibly present within the enormous chamber.
artworks.captionSl: Monumentalna figura, obdana z zlatimi instrumenti, pred seboj drži modri svet. Pod njo stoji drobna Illuminara, a ostaja jasno navzoča v velikanski dvorani.

artworks.title: Veyondar Rescue
artworks.caption: In a corridor breaking apart into light, Illuminara stays close to a companion as a white-clad figure approaches. The collapsing surroundings make every step uncertain.
artworks.captionSl: Na hodniku, ki se razpada v svetlobo, Illuminara ostaja ob spremljevalcu, medtem ko se približuje figura v belem. Razpadajoča okolica naredi vsak korak negotov.

artworks.title: Nara Between The Everpresence and The One Beyond
artworks.caption: Two vast luminous presences face one another across the stars. Illuminara stands between them with an open hand, unmistakably human within a scene of impossible scale.
artworks.captionSl: Dve neizmerni svetleči prisotnosti si stojita nasproti med zvezdami. Illuminara stoji med njima z odprto dlanjo, nedvomno človeška v prizoru nemogočih razsežnosti.

captionPolicy: Image-observed two-sentence editorial descriptions in English and Slovenian; no narrative canon promotion.
